			create_country_leader = { name = "Turkish National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_institution.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = neutral_Social }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 19 }
			}
			create_country_leader = { name = "Turkish National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_institution.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Neutral_Communism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 20 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_alparslan_turkes
					date > 1969.12.31
					date < 2000.1.1
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Alparslan Türkeş" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_alparslan_turkes.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Populism }
			}
			else = {
				create_country_leader = { name = "Alparslan Türkeş" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_alparslan_turkes.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Populism }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 21 }
			}
			create_country_leader = { name = "Turkish National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_institution.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Fascism }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 22 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_memduh_tagmac
					date > 1969.12.31
					date < 1972.8.29
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Memduh Tağmaç" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_memduh_tagmac.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_faruk_gurler
					date > 1970.8.27
					date < 1973.3.6
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Ömer Faruk Gürler" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_faruk_gurler.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_semih_sancar
					date > 1972.8.27
					date < 1978.3.7
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Semih Sancar" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_semih_sancar.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_kenan_evren
					date > 1977.9.4
					date < 1983.7.1
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Ahmet Kenan Evren" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_kenan_evren.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_turgut_sunalp
					date > 1983.5.15
					date < 2000.1.1
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Turgut Sunalp" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_turgut_sunalp.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_selected_bulend_ulusu
					date > 1980.9.19
					date < 2000.1.1
				}
				create_country_leader = { name = "Bülend Ulusu" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_bulend_ulusu.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						date < 1972.8.29
					}
					create_country_leader = { name = "Memduh Tağmaç" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_memduh_tagmac.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
				}
				else = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							date < 1973.3.6
						}
						create_country_leader = { name = "Ömer Faruk Gürler" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_faruk_gurler.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
					}
					else = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								date < 1978.3.7
							}
							create_country_leader = { name = "Semih Sancar" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_semih_sancar.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
						}
						else = {
							create_country_leader = { name = "Ahmet Kenan Evren" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_kenan_evren.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Nat_Autocracy }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ruling_party = 23 }
			}
			create_country_leader = { name = "Turkish National Administration" picture = "gfx/leaders/TUR/1970/COLDWAR_TUR_1970_institution.dds" expire = "2000.1.1" ideology = Monarchist }
		}
		set_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_leader_party = ruling_party }
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialize = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = TUR
			exists = yes
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
		}
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_retire_modern_roster = yes
		COLDWAR_TUR_1970_refresh_roster = yes
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_assets_8b40bbff034d } NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_TUR_1970_leader_party = ruling_party } } }
			}
			COLDWAR_TUR_1970_set_leader = yes
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_assets_8b40bbff034d
		}
	}
}

COLDWAR_TUR_1970_daily_tick = {
	COLDWAR_TUR_1970_initialize = yes
}
